overview: The F-15C HOTAS is built around the APG-63 radar and the air-to-air weapons. The throttle WEAPON SELECT switch (GUN / SRM / MRM) is the primary 'mode' control: with the Radar Set Control in AUTO it also reconfigures the radar (SRM = short-range search, MRM = long-range interleaved search, GUN = gun auto-acquisition scan). The Target Designator Control (TDC) on the throttle moves the acquisition symbol and is pressed to lock or designate - the equivalent of F-16 TMS forward. The TDC has one owner at a time, the VSD (default, shown by the solid captain's bars) or the MPCD SIT display, and the stick CASTLE switch hands it between them. The stick AUTO ACQ switch gives hands-on Supersearch / Boresight / Vertical Scan auto-lock and Return-To-Search, while the throttle COOLIE (multifunction) switch manages TWS designation, MRM slave/boresight, AAI interrogation and the ICS jammer. There is no F-16 style SOI or DMS logic. Note: BMS models the F-15 with the F-15E-style stick grip, and several F-15C functions are still marked WIP or not implemented (N/I) in the 4.38 documents.

buttons.name: Trigger (2-stage)
buttons.summary: Second detent fires the 20 mm gun.

actions.general: Starts the VTR (video tape recorder). Not implemented in BMS.
Fires the M61 20 mm gun when MASTER ARM is in ARM.

byMode.effect: Normal gun attack with the LCOS/gun reticle (radar in gun auto-acq).
The gun can still be fired (ADI master mode also allows gun firing).

buttons.name: Weapon Release (Pickle) Button
buttons.summary: Launches the selected missile (A/A) or releases the selected A/G store.

actions.general: Active with MASTER ARM in ARM. In the A/A master mode it launches the selected MRM or SRM.

byMode.effect: Hold the button for more than 1 s to start the firing sequence. A momentary 'short pickle' can leave the store HUNG; step past it with BOAT forward.
Launch is initiated immediately on depression.
Launch is initiated immediately on depression.
Releases the selected air-to-ground store (A/G button lit with MRM or SRM selected; missile launch circuits disabled). A/G mode is only partially implemented.

buttons.bmsNotes: Launching A/A weapons in the ADI and VI master modes is not yet implemented. Callback SimF15WeaponRelease.

buttons.name: Trim Button (trim hat)

actions.general: Nose-down trim (moves the neutral stick position).
Nose-up trim.
Roll left trim.
Roll right trim.

buttons.bmsNotes: Unlike the F-16 fly-by-wire, the F-15C does not trim itself to 1 g, so expect to trim in different flight regimes. In flight the flight control system does auto-trim the stabilator for speed, flap, speed brake and store changes. The separate T/O TRIM button (left console) is WIP.

buttons.name: Castle Switch
buttons.summary: Assigns TDC priority (VSD or SIT) and selects MPCD SIT display modes.

actions.general: Toggles TDC control between the VSD and the MPCD SIT display. The display that owns the TDC shows a solid acquisition symbol; the other shows a dashed / 'ghost' (blue) cursor.

byMode.effect: TDC moves to the SIT: the captain's bars disappear from the VSD and the white SIT TDC cursor appears centered on ownship (SIT range bumping then available).
TDC returns to the VSD (radar acquisition).
TDC automatically returns to the VSD at power-up or whenever the radar enters any auto-acq mode.

actions.general: Toggles the SIT FORMATION display (ownship-centered, auto-zoomed to show all flight members' data link symbols). If another MPCD page is displayed, the first castle aft selects the SIT display.
Toggles the SIT display between self-centered and decentered formats (Dash-1: returns to last SIT display / toggles centered-decentered).
SIT EXPANDED mode: 10 NM display centered on the TDC cursor (WIP).
A castle press callback exists in the F-15 key file but no function is documented (WIP).

buttons.bmsNotes: Callbacks SimF15CastleUp / Down / Left / Right / Push (F-15 Full key file). To reference the BMS bullseye on the SIT, a steerpoint must be placed on the bullseye during planning.

buttons.name: Auto Acquisition Switch / Air Refueling Release
buttons.summary: Four-position (FWD / AFT / DOWN / OFF, spring-return) switch for radar auto-acquisition modes, TWS/STT transitions and Return-To-Search.

actions.general: Auto-acquisition / scan selection depending on radar state.

byMode.effect: 1st press: SUPERSEARCH (SS) - 6-bar scan of the 20x20 deg HUD field of view, 10 NM, auto-locks the first target (500 ft-10 NM); 20 deg circle in the HUD. 2nd press while in SS: BORESIGHT (BST) - antenna along the radar bore line, 4 deg HUD steering circle, locks the first target out to 10 NM. SS cannot be entered from TWS or STT.
Toggles 3-bar / 4-bar NDTWS.
Toggles 3-bar HDTWS / 4-bar TWS (N/I).
Toggles 2 / 3-bar D/HDTWS (N/I).
Selects non-designated high-data-rate TWS (N/I).
BST, SS or vertical scan may be selected from within the GUN auto-acq scan.

actions.general: LONG RANGE BORESIGHT (LR BST): IPRF search along the radar bore line from 3000 ft to 40 NM, 2.5 deg HUD steering circle, radar range scale set to 40 NM; locks into MSTT/HSTT.
Vertical scan / TWS-STT transitions.

byMode.effect: VERTICAL SCAN auto-acq: 2-bar, 7.5 deg wide scan from +5 to +55 deg above the FRL, locks 500 ft-10 NM (aircraft stabilized).
Hold TDC depressed and pull auto acq aft (< 1 s): enters Non-Designated TWS (NDTWS).
Commands STT on the radar priority target.
Brief aft: enters designated TWS (DTWS) with a track file built from the STT target.

actions.general: RETURN TO SEARCH (RTS): drops all locks/tracks and returns to the search mode selected on the Radar Set Control panel. Also used to exit an auto-acq mode, and releases the air refueling receptacle (boom disconnect).

byMode.effect: RTS after a GUN-mode lock returns the radar to the GUN auto-acq scan (scan re-centered at 0 deg).
Momentary RTS abandons the lock-on attempt and returns to the selected search mode.

buttons.bmsNotes: Auto-acq selections are disabled once track is established - RTS is required first. If an auto-acq attempt fails to enter track, the radar returns to the previously selected auto-acq mode, not to search. Callbacks SimF15AutoAcqSwitchFwd / Aft / Down.

buttons.name: Nose Gear Steering Button
buttons.summary: Selects nose gear 'maneuvering' steering on the ground; cages/uncages the AIM-9 in SRM.

actions.general: Activates the nose gear steering MANEUVER range: steering limit increases from 15 deg (normal, engaged automatically with WOW) to 45 deg - for tight taxiing/parking.
Cages / uncages the priority AIM-9 seeker (lets the seeker self-track; press again to re-cage).

byMode.effect: AIM-9 cage/uncage (Dash-1 describes this as 'in ACM mode').

buttons.bmsNotes: In BMS this button does NOT interrogate IFF (AAI interrogation is COOLIE left) and does NOT disconnect air refueling (that is AUTO ACQ down). Callback SimF15NoseGearSteering.

buttons.name: Autopilot / Steering Disengage Switch (Paddle Switch)
buttons.summary: Multi-function: NWS disable on the ground, autopilot disconnect, or countermeasures program MAN 1.

actions.general: Function depends on conditions, in this priority order:

byMode.effect: Disables nose wheel steering for as long as it is held - hold it during the takeoff roll once aligned and after nose-gear touchdown on landing, then release to re-enable NWS below control speed.
Disengages the autopilot (ALT/ATT hold).

byMode.mode: Airborne, A/A or A/G master mode, no autopilot
byMode.effect: Dispenses countermeasure program MAN 1 (ALE-45). Holding does not repeat the program - release and press again.

buttons.bmsNotes: Callback SimF15PaddleSwitch. CMD mode MAN ONLY / SEMI / AUTO all accept MAN 1 commands; a manual program supersedes an RWR-based program.

buttons.name: Target Designator Control (TDC)
buttons.summary: Force-sensitive cursor for the VSD acquisition symbol or SIT cursor, with a press 'action' position to lock / designate.

actions.general: Moves the acquisition symbol on the display that owns the TDC at a rate proportional to force: left/right = azimuth, up/down = range.

byMode.effect: Moves the captain's bars. Range bump: bars to the top (99%) / bottom (1%) of the VSD select the next higher / lower range scale and re-center the bars. Azimuth bump: pushing against the side edge changes the azimuth scan (BMS currently alternates 120 / 20 deg from LRS). Not available with dashed bars.
Manual range bumping of the display scale (suspends automatic STT range switching until STT is exited).
Moves the bars over track files for quick pick; NDTWS scan is centered under the TDC cursor (with antenna elevation).
Positionable SS: full up shifts the scan to +28 deg, full down to -19 deg; a momentary opposite input returns it to center (-4 deg).
Adjusts the acquisition scan azimuth while the lock-on command is active (elevation with the antenna elevation control).
Moves the SIT cursor (bearing/range shown); slewing to the top / bottom of the SIT bumps the SIT range up / down.

actions.general: Designate / lock-on - effectively the F-15 'TMS up'.

byMode.effect: Press: antenna slews to the bars' azimuth and runs a +/-3 deg two-bar mini-raster within the selected bars. Release within 1 s: lock-on command (radar correlates stored hits, then STT). If no lock within 1.5 s the acquisition scan continues until RTS.
QUICK PICK: bars over any designated or undesignated track file, press < 1 s = make it the Primary Designated Target (PDT); from NDTWS this enters DTWS.
Press and HOLD the TDC over empty space, then pull AUTO ACQ aft < 1 s to enter Non-Designated TWS.

buttons.bmsNotes: BMS 4.38 known bug (Dash-34): the TDC lock is commanded on TDC PRESS, not on release. The TDC can be bound to the Cursor X/Y axes or to 8 direction callbacks (SimF15TargetDesignatorCursorUp... ) plus SimF15TargetDesignatorControl for the press.

buttons.name: Weapon Select Switch (GUN / SRM / MRM)
buttons.summary: Selects the A/A weapon class and, with the radar in AUTO, configures the radar for it.

actions.general: Selects the 20 mm gun submode and the radar GUN auto-acquisition scan (60 deg wide, 6-bar 20 deg high, auto-lock 0.5-15 NM, parameters cannot be changed). Deselects any lit master mode button (returns the HUD to the A/A gun attack display).

byMode.effect: Radar transitions to STT on the PDT.
Radar returns to search and enters the GUN scan.
Inhibits TWS entry (TWS is blocked in GUN).

actions.general: Short-range missile (AIM-9) submode; radar enters short-range search (MPRF). Coolie then toggles the AIM-9 seeker between missile boresight and radar LOS; NWS button cages/uncages.

byMode.effect: Radar initialized to 20 NM, RSC azimuth scan, six-bar elevation scan.
Azimuth scan unchanged; range limited to 80 NM; minimum four-bar elevation scan unless the RSC is set higher.
SRM or MRM plus the A/G master mode button selects A/G mode (A/G RNG radar, A/G release circuits).

actions.general: Medium-range missile (AIM-7 / AIM-120) submode; radar enters long-range search, interleaved HPRF/MPRF.

byMode.effect: Range and azimuth scan unchanged; elevation bars as set on the RSC.
Range, azimuth and elevation scan as selected on the Radar Set Control panel.

buttons.bmsNotes: Radar CONTR knob must be in AUTO (the only implemented mode). For HOTAS with few buttons, the 'Modes - Cycle' callback (SimF15CycleModes) steps GUN > SRM > MRM; individual callbacks SimF15SelectGUN / SRM / MRM.

buttons.name: BOAT Switch
buttons.summary: Selects / rejects missiles within the selected weapon class.

actions.general: Selects/steps weapons. MRM: changes between AIM-7 and AIM-120. SRM: cycles and steps over the AIM-9s. Also used to step from a HUNG store to the next missile in the firing sequence.
Selects/rejects weapons (the Dash-1 lists FWD and AFT without assigning separate functions).

buttons.bmsNotes: In the F-15C docs the BOAT switch is a weapon select/reject switch, not the countermeasures dispenser (that is the ECM Dispenser Switch). Automatic selection of the next station after a hung store is N/I. Callbacks SimF15BoatSwitchFWD / AFT.

buttons.name: Multifunction (Coolie) Switch
buttons.summary: TWS target management, MRM slave/boresight, AAI interrogation (left) and ICS jammer (right).

actions.general: TWS designation / Quick Step.

byMode.effect: No function.
Designates the radar priority target (shortest missile TOF) as PDT - enters DTWS.
QUICK STEP: moves the PDT (golf tee) to the next designated track in the shoot list (next in range / left-to-right), updating TTI for the next missile; up to 8 designated targets.

actions.general: Undesignate / MRM boresight / reticle functions.

byMode.effect: Toggles MRM SLAVE / BORESIGHT. In BORESIGHT all MRMs are non-functioning and attack steering and DLZ disappear from HUD and VSD - an inadvertent press can prevent MRM employment.
No function.
Deselects the designated targets (returns to NDTWS).
Press and hold: LCOS reticle stiffen (UNLOCK only; gun cross harmonized at 1000 ft instead of 2250 ft).
Short press: cages the HUD velocity vector in azimuth for crosswind (flashing while caged).

actions.general: Starts an Air-to-Air Interrogator (AAI / IFF) interrogation. Only Mode 4 in AUTO is implemented (AAI panel on the left console); replies are shown on the VSD as high-confidence (circle) or low-confidence symbols. WIP.
ICS (AN/ALQ-135) jammer control.

byMode.effect: Activates the ECM transmitters (jams only when TEWS detects a threat tracking you); subsequent presses toggle ECM STANDBY / ACTIVE.
No function (ECM always active).

buttons.bmsNotes: With SRM selected and an AIM-9 as priority missile the coolie toggles the AIM-9 seeker between missile boresight and radar LOS (the docs do not specify the direction). The ALQ-135 is WIP in BMS and borrows the F-16 ECM logic. Callbacks SimF15CoolieUp / Down / Left / Right.

buttons.name: Antenna Elevation Control
buttons.summary: Spring-loaded rate control that moves the radar scan center in elevation.

actions.input: Rotate aft / forward (spring returns to center)
actions.general: Rotating aft moves the scan center UP, forward moves it down, within +/-40 deg. It is a rate control (about +/-30 deg of travel): ~3 deg deflection does nothing, up to 23 deg commands 3000 ft/s of scan-center altitude change at the acquisition-symbol range, full deflection up to 15,000 ft/s. Watch the elevation caret and altitude coverage on the VSD.

byMode.effect: Positions the center of the selected bar pattern; with TDC, centers the NDTWS scan and the manual acquisition scan.
Not used.

buttons.bmsNotes: On exiting STT, search elevation initializes to the target's elevation; elevation resets to zero on exiting SS, BST, LR BST, vertical scan or GUN auto-acq, and when returning from A/G to A/A. Callbacks SimF15RdrElevControlUp / Down.

buttons.name: Speedbrake Switch
buttons.summary: Extends or retracts the dorsal speed brake.

actions.general: Extends the speed brake (any intermediate position below 25 units AOA; above 25 units it will not extend / auto-retracts, and re-extends when AOA drops if the switch is still aft).
Stops the speed brake in its current intermediate position.
Retracts the speed brake.

buttons.bmsNotes: With the gear down the speed brake opens fully only with the switch held aft; the Training Manual recommends the center (about half open) position on final. There is no toggle callback yet - bind SimF15SpeedBrakeFwd / Aft. SPD BK OUT caution light when extended.

buttons.name: Microphone Switch

actions.general: Transmit on radio 1 (UHF1 per the BMS F-15 callback list).
Transmit on radio 2 (UHF2 per the BMS F-15 callback list).

buttons.bmsNotes: The Dash-1 describes it only as 'VHF and UHF control'; the Technical Manual labels FWD = UHF1, AFT = UHF2. Callbacks SimF15MicrophoneFwd / Aft.

buttons.name: ECM Dispenser Switch (chaff/flare, MAN 2)
buttons.summary: Throttle countermeasures dispense switch - program MAN 2.

actions.general: Not used.
Off.
Manual dispense: runs countermeasure program 2 (MAN 2). Holding does not repeat - release and press again.

byMode.effect: Dispenses program 2 (patterns from ALR-56C / PFM / DTC program).
When the green PROGRAM light shows an RWR-based program is ready, MAN 2 initiates that dispense; a further MAN 1/MAN 2 command runs the manual program instead.
Dispensing is automatic; a MAN 2 command overrides the RWR-based program.

buttons.bmsNotes: Dispensing is prevented on the ground with weight on wheels. MAN 1 is on the stick paddle switch. Callbacks SimF15CounterMeasuresDispenserUp / Center / Down.

buttons.name: Finger Lift Switches (Left & Right)
buttons.summary: Engage the JFS to the respective engine for start.

actions.general: Engages the JFS to the left engine for start; advance that throttle to IDLE at about 25% RPM.
Engages the JFS to the right engine for start; advance that throttle to IDLE at about 25% RPM.

buttons.bmsNotes: Callbacks SimF15FingerLiftEngineLeft / Right. Separate generic TQS callbacks exist for moving each throttle between IDLE and OFF (left/right throttle CUTOFF).

buttons.name: SBR Switch
buttons.summary: Shown on the throttle diagram - not implemented in BMS.

actions.general: No function in BMS 4.38 (listed as not implemented). A related 'Special Burst Ranging' callback is marked NIY.
